summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that shareholders, J.B.D Innovation Ltd. and Victor Tshuva Co. Law Offices, commenced legal proceedings in the Haifa District Court challenging a private placement of 1,000,000 ordinary shares and warrants to an institutional investor announced July 31, 2026. The court issued an ex parte interim order barring advancement of the placement and any capital structure changes, requiring the plaintiffs to post NIS 250,000 security plus an unlimited third-party guarantee. The hearing was advanced to August 12, 2026. The company filed a response seeking to vacate the order. Completion of the private placement is uncertain pending litigation outcome.
